home.title: Bambyul Blog
home.description: I write about problems I encounter while developing software and what I learn along the way.

about.title: Jingeon Kim
about.headline: Building things, running them, and writing down the reasons behind the choices.
about.description: Hi, I'm Jingeon, a frontend developer working with React and Next.js. I like following a problem beyond the screen—through APIs, data, and deployment—to understand what it takes to solve it.
about.perspective: This blog is a record of the places I got stuck and the decisions I made along the way. Rather than listing the tools I used, I try to explain why I chose an approach and what happened when I tested it. That includes failed attempts and ideas I later changed my mind about.

topics.title: What I write about
topics.intro: Questions that come up while turning a feature into something usable.

interface.title: Interfaces and user experience
interface.description: React rendering and state, the boundary between server and client, and the small usability issues that only show up in a real browser.

design.title: Boundaries in code and data
design.description: How to split responsibilities, what APIs and data should promise, and the changes I made when those boundaries stopped working.

operation.title: Beyond the first working version
operation.description: Problems found through testing, deployment, and monitoring. I'm interested in the work between code running locally and a service people can use.

projects.title: Learning by building
projects.intro: Side projects give me a place to turn an idea into an interface and working code, then revisit the choices I made.

gameMate.title: Game Mate
gameMate.description: A gaming companion service that began with paid friend adds and coaching. I'm adding a feedback board to the experience of finding someone to play with.

contest.title: Byeolsadae
contest.description: A community for sharing photos and videos and responding to each other's posts. It's a place to explore public feeds, group spaces, and participation permissions.

blog.title: Bambyul Blog
blog.description: The site you're reading now. I write about development in Korean and English and keep the articles alongside the code in Git.

about.contactDescription: Have a thought about an article or something you'd like to discuss? You're welcome to get in touch.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This blog is read without an account or comments, and collects visit statistics and heatmaps to improve its articles and usability. If you prefer not to be measured, turn collection off for this browser under ‘Turn off collection’ below.

analytics.heading: Visit statistics (Google Analytics)
analytics.body: The blog sends the visited page address (without search terms or hash), the previous page address, the page title, and events such as language changes, shares, category and tag selections, and whether a search was made. Search terms themselves are never sent. Google Analytics also processes device and browser information and an approximate location derived from the IP address, and stores cookies starting with _ga.

heatmaps.heading: Heatmaps and session replay (Microsoft Clarity)
heatmaps.body: The blog records click and scroll positions and page movement to build heatmaps and session replays. The search field is masked. Clarity stores cookies such as _clck and _clsk, and does not set cookies for visitors from the EEA, UK and Switzerland without a consent signal.

processors.heading: Processors and international transfer
processors.body: Collected information is processed by Google LLC and Microsoft Corporation and may be stored on servers in other countries, including the United States. Advertising storage and ad personalization signals are not used.

retention.heading: Retention
retention.body: Data is kept for the retention period configured in each service and is then deleted by that service.

optOut.heading: Turn off collection
optOut.body: Use the button below to turn visit statistics and heatmaps off or back on for this browser. Turning them off deletes the Google Analytics cookies, stops sending data and stops Clarity. Your choice is stored only in this browser.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: Send questions about this notice to the email address below.
